title: What the session hooks are told: whose name a commit or a push in this repo carries, and what is asked of the person.

protected.description: Paths an edit to which is asked of the person, and which a stop lists when the branch changes them. Relative to the top of any working tree; a path ending in / is a directory and all below it; * stands for any part of one name.

reported.description: Paths a stop lists when the branch changes them, and an edit to which is not asked about.

lens_inputs.description: Each file a required deterministic Lens reads to judge a change, by the Lens's name in config/defaults.json, in the syntax of the paths above. A stop lists them as it lists what is reported, and the Kernel is given them with the protected paths: a change to one converges only once every model Lens has reviewed it.

merging.description: What merges a pull request or adds one to the queue: a push to the branch, a gh command, a GraphQL mutation or a REST endpoint written to.

settings.description: What writes a ruleset or the repo's settings: a gh command, a GraphQL mutation or a REST endpoint written to. A command in reads only reads, though it starts as one of the commands does.

commands.description: gh's words for a command, after gh and its options; a longer command starting with them counts too. A word starting -- is an option the command must carry.

mutations.description: GraphQL mutation names; * stands for any part of a name.

endpoints.description: REST paths written to with any method but GET or HEAD. * stands for one part, and a final /** for any number of parts, none included.
